text: International Holding Company (IHC) is controlled by the Royal Group, the conglomerate of Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Abu Dhabi's deputy ruler.
short: IHC is controlled by Sheikh Tahnoon's Royal Group

source.name: International Investor Magazine: Abu Dhabi IHC adds stake in the main constructor in the United Arab Emirates with the latest agreement
source.quote: Ultimately, IHC is controlled by the Royal Group, a conglomerate that includes Sheikh Tahnoon Bin Zayed Al Nahyan as president
source.note: Reuters (2024-01-02, 'Abu Dhabi's IHC forms new company...') reports Royal Group owns a 61% stake in IHC; the reuters.com page blocks scripts, so it was read via its published abstract only.
